title: [Nichibei] Smartphone Lesson List – Collect Attendance Roster – Archived Student Excluded, Including Booking Remark (Control Case)
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case, not a gap: Code-confirmed this Smartphone-view roster shares the exact same Is_Archived__c-filtered query and dialog as the already-covered desktop Collect Attendance entry points.
preconditions:
Logged into BO as a Nichibei staff user on the Smartphone view
Published Lesson X has Student A (booked via Nichibei Lesson Booking, remark = "Please arrange front row seat", stored with "Booking Note:" prefix) and Student B (active, no remark) both assigned
Status filter = "Published" (default)
steps_actions:
1. "Staff taps into Lesson X's Collect Attendance entry point from the Smartphone Lesson List"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "Staff reopens Lesson X's Collect Attendance entry point from the Smartphone Lesson List"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "Staff reopens the Collect Attendance entry point"
steps_result:
1. "Both Student A (with 'Booking Note: Please arrange front row seat' shown read-only) and Student B appear in the roster"
2. "Student A's Student Session becomes Is_Archived__c = TRUE via formula"
3. "Student A no longer appears in the roster at all - neither their attendance row nor their booking remark leaks through; Student B is unaffected"
4. "Student A's Student Session returns to Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
5. "Student A reappears in the roster with their original booking remark intact ('Booking Note: Please arrange front row seat')"
steps_data:
1. "Both sessions Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A excluded by Lesson_GetStudentSessionAttendance's Is_Archived__c = FALSE filter"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Same Student_Sessions__c record, Attendance_Response__c unchanged by the archive/restore cycle"
